subject: Re: Security + Private VPC deployment options — follow-up & next steps
messages:
From: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@acme-analytics.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-05T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Security & Private VPC — follow-up from today's call

Hi Marcus / Dev,

Thanks again for the call today — we found the discussion about Redwood's Private/VPC options really helpful. I wanted to capture the asks and next steps on our side so we can move quickly: 

1) SOC 2 status & report: Can you confirm whether Redwood currently has SOC 2 Type II? If so, can you share the latest report (or provide the procedure to obtain it)?
2) GDPR / HIPAA: We need confirmation of GDPR controls and whether Redwood supports HIPAA (BAA) for private deployments. Any summary you can share is great.
3) Vendor security questionnaire (SSQ): Our security team will initiate a formal SSQ. Please confirm the best contact to send it to and an expected turnaround time.
4) Private deployment posture: We discussed network isolation, VPC peering vs. dedicated tenancy, and air-gapped on-prem options. Could you share the deployment diagram(s) and any constraints for offline/air-gapped installs?

Next steps from Acme: we'll kick off the SSQ once we have the contact and any relevant attachments. Can you also include a short list of required artifacts (e.g., SOC 2 report, pen test summary, architecture diagram, encryption/certificate info)?

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-min follow-up if helpful.

Best,
Alice Nguyen
Sr. Security Program Manager
Acme Analytics

---
Acme Analytics (external)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-05T17:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security & Private VPC — follow-up from today's call

Hi Alice — great to speak earlier, thanks for the clear recap. Below are answers and attachments to help your security team get started.

1) SOC 2: Redwood has completed SOC 2 Type II for our hosted offering; for Private/VPC deployments we provide scoped attestation and customer-specific evidence under NDA. I attached a short security brief that outlines our SOC 2 coverage and the steps to request the full report.

2) GDPR / HIPAA: We are GDPR-compliant across our platform; data processing addenda are available. For HIPAA, we do support Business Associate Agreements for Private deployments and on-prem packages. I included the high-level controls in the security brief.

3) SSQ contact & turnaround: Please send the SSQ to security@redwood.com. Our security ops team typically triages vendor questionnaires within 5 business days for initial review and 7–10 business days for full completion depending on scope. If there are certs/reports requested (e.g., pen test, SOC), mention them in the first pass and we can prioritize.

4) Private / VPC / on-prem posture: See attached deployment diagram (redwood-private-vpc-deployment-diagram.pdf). Key notes:
   - VPC deployments use customer-managed VPC peering or PrivateLink (region-dependent).
   - Dedicated tenancy and reserved GPU pools available for Dedicated plans.
   - For air-gapped / on-prem installs we provide an offline installer and documentation; network isolation requires an approved maintenance and update process with signed manifests.
   - KMS/HSM integrations supported for key management; audit logs are available via the Private control plane.

Attachments included: redwood-security-brief.pdf (high-level controls & SOC 2 summary), redwood-private-vpc-deployment-diagram.pdf (diagram + notes).

Proposed next steps:
- I'll loop in Marissa from Solutions (cc'd) to coordinate the SSQ intake and to track any procurement/contract items.
- If helpful, we can schedule a 30–45 minute session with our Security Ops to walk through the SSQ and the diagram.

Let me know your preferred cadence.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Enterprise Sales — Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-security-brief.pdf (application/pdf), redwood-private-vpc-deployment-diagram.pdf (application/pdf)

Hi Marissa / Marcus,

Thanks — we've started the SSQ and sent the initial questionnaire to security@redwood.com (you should see a Docusign/SSQ link from our vendor portal). For planning: our security team expects responses to the initial questionnaire within 7–10 business days and any requested artifacts (SOC 2, pen test summary, deployment diagram).

A couple clarifying Qs from our side:
- For on‑prem / air‑gapped installs, do you have an expected timeline for a standard install and validation (internal acceptance testing)?
- For Private VPC: can you outline any networking prerequisites from our infra team (e.g., egress rules, required endpoints, port ranges)?

If useful, we can schedule the walkthrough the week of 7/11.

Best,
Alice

Acme Analytics
